activity.notes: Oswald became King of Northumbria in 634 and was killed in battle in 642. ATLAS uses the historical Northumbrian kingdom rather than a generic Anglo-Saxon polity.

sources.title: History of Lindisfarne Priory — English Heritage
sources.citation_text: English Heritage identifies Oswald as the Northumbrian king who reigned 634-642 and describes the political composition of Northumbria.
